claims.gist: CDR detects active cloud threats, unlike posture tools that flag misconfigurations
EDR and XDR have limited visibility into cloud control-plane activity and identity abuse
SIEMs need manual detection building and usually have thin cloud context
Test vendor detection quality with attack simulations, not just demos
Automated response that cannot be controlled is a risk
Model CDR vendor pricing at real scale, including ephemeral resources

thesis: CDR targets active cloud attacks; buyers should judge vendors on detection quality, context, response control and cost.
